FTR:
Flakes should be removed from our infra as they make our tests results are to read, thus flakes are P1. 
Breakage indicate we have them on CI for the sheriff to be able to find rapidly already existing bugs

I looked at the source code and I didn't find anything wrong.
I added debugging info in https://bazel-review.googlesource.com/c/bazel/+/15911,  I hope that'll shed some light on this mystery. If not, I'll keep adding debug data *until morale improves* ;)

issue.title: Installation became corrupt on Windows

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
Running release 0.4.5 on Windows 8.1.
I've been using bazel without issue for a few weeks. I last invoked it successfully ~24hrs earlier and then when I went to invoke it just now got the following error:

```
λ bazel [...]
Error: corrupt installation: file 'C:\Users\Ben\AppData\Local\Temp/_bazel_Ben/install/90e1e9f8d81688fd3cc9a8cf18c2ad4e/_embedded_binaries/A-server.jar' missing. Please remove 'C:\Users\Ben\AppData\Local\Temp/_bazel_Ben/install/90e1e9f8d81688fd3cc9a8cf18c2ad4e' and try again.
```

Unfortunately I followed the directions without hesitating and deleted the path without first checking what it looked like. It fixed the issue and bazel was able to re-extract itself and function however now I can't say what the state of the install folder was.

I see a few other issues that have been filed with this error message but were closed/fixed. Wanted to open something up in case there was either a new variant or an unfixed underlying issue.
